title: A Yearbook for the Locker
author: Ines Underhill
blurb: Rafael Kavanagh, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
